speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to begin our evaluation, have you experienced any sudden onset of severe abdominal or pelvic pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your age and the findings, is there any history of ovarian cancer in your mother or sisters? Also, have you noticed any bloating, early satiety, or increasing abdominal girth recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Intermittent bleeding from the vagina. I also have No recent weight loss, No fever, No changes in bladder or bowel habits.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Carcinoma. Please proceed with immediate staging workup including CA-125, transvaginal ultrasound, and CT abdomen/pelvis.
